title: Food Pantry Volunteer
organization: Lutheran Social Services of the Southwest
location: First Evangelical Food Pantry, Tucson, AZ
schedule_flexibility: Tuesday and Thursday mornings only; orientation required
description: Welcome guests, sort donations, pack food boxes for clients, help open/clean food pantry. Occasional food delivery assistance.
requirements: Virtual volunteer orientation, ability to welcome guests and sort donations

title: General Shelter Volunteer
hours_note: Minimum average of 2 hours per week; six-month commitment requested; volunteers may sign up for as many hours as their availability allows
schedule_flexibility: Multiple roles (dog walking, cat socialization, fostering, events, thrift store); HSSA Adoptions open Mon-Sat 11am-6pm, Sun 12-5pm; most opportunities within these hours
description: Walk dogs, socialize cats, foster animals, clean, provide customer service at adoptions, thrift store shifts. Variety of low-to-moderate physical roles.
requirements: Age 15+ (non-adults max 3 hrs/day, 12 hrs/wk); background check; orientation; willingness to work hard

title: Shelter Volunteer (Dog Walker / Adoption Counselor / Greeter)
hours_note: If you can spare 4 to 5 hours once a week, we could sure use you (per PACC Facebook); one shift per week
schedule_flexibility: Evening shifts most needed; weekday and weekend availability welcomed; East and West campus options
description: Dog walking (large breeds 40+ lbs), adoption counseling, greeter crew, administrative support, medical cat care. Roles for all abilities at both campuses.
requirements: Age 18+, orientation and tour, must safely handle large dogs for walker role, waiver required

title: Animal Care Team Volunteer
hours_note: Complete shifts that are 4 hours during slow season and 5 hours during busy season; commit to one scheduled shift per week; maintain a minimum six-month commitment
schedule_flexibility: One scheduled shift per week; slow season 4 hrs, busy season 5 hrs; overnight phone volunteer role also available
description: Direct wildlife care and rehabilitation; prepare diets, clean enclosures, assist with medical treatments. Overnight phone shifts: answer wildlife emergency calls, guide callers, coordinate admissions.
requirements: Six-month commitment, training provided, dependable and compassionate, ability to follow protocols

title: Hospice Companion Volunteer
location: Tucson, Marana, and Green Valley, AZ
hours_note: As little as 1 hour per week, whenever it fits your schedule; volunteers can choose their own schedule and area they are comfortable working in
schedule_flexibility: Fully flexible; volunteers choose their own schedule and service area (Tucson, Marana, Green Valley)
description: Provide companionship and comfort to hospice patients and their families. Bring smiles and meaningful connection during end-of-life journey.
requirements: Compassionate demeanor, background check, training provided, reliable transportation for patient visits
contact: Apply via PrismHR listing or contact Dependable Hospice directly

title: Community Resource Volunteer
location: Remote (Bay Area, LA, Gainesville FL focus; open to US)
hours_note: Time Commitment: 5-15 hours a week (or updating a minimum of 20 resources per week), for 3-6 months, remote, flexible hours
schedule_flexibility: Fully remote, flexible hours; unpaid volunteer position
description: Update and maintain database of 22k+ community resources in Bay Area and LA counties; verify resource accuracy, add new resources, ensure low-income families have access to current life-affirming services.
requirements: Age 18+, basic computer/data entry skills, written/verbal communication skills, ability to work independently, strong proofreading skills, access to computer

title: Virtual Mentor
hours_note: Invest 1 hour per week with a child; virtual mentoring through secure online platform DreamCloud; school-year commitment
schedule_flexibility: Weekly online sessions; three mentors matched with small group of 3-6 students; flexible scheduling
description: Mentor youth through Dream Journey workbook curriculum over school year; build resilience, social engagement, and support network. Virtual platform removes distance barriers.
requirements: Background check, training provided, commitment to school year, comfortable with video calls

title: E-Mentor
hours_note: One-year commitment of 4 hours per month (approx. 1 hour per week) via video or chat; mentors and mentees connect on secure mobile-friendly app
schedule_flexibility: Flexible schedule via mobile app; video or chat; mentors and mentees set their own meeting times
description: Support young adults 18-26 aging out of foster care; build life skills and work toward personal goals through structured e-mentoring platform with group learning opportunities.
requirements: One-year commitment, 4 hours/month minimum, background check, training provided, comfortable with mobile/video technology

title: Crisis Line Volunteer
hours_note: Minimum of 200 hours answering calls — that's one 4-hour shift per week for a year; interns commit 12-16 hours per week over 2 shifts
schedule_flexibility: 4-hour shifts; shift availability varies; training over 74 hours (hybrid virtual/in-office); minimum 6 months for interns
description: Answer crisis calls on 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline and other lines; use computerized call management and reporting systems; extensive professional skills training provided.
requirements: 74+ hours training (hybrid), background check, minimum 200 hours (one 4-hr shift/week for a year), must be reliable and empathetic
